The Origin Kathu-Patong

Condominium in Kathu-Patong
HomePhuket PropertyCondos for SaleThe Origin Kathu-Patong

Renders and photos from the Keller Henson project page for The Origin Kathu-Patong. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

The Origin Kathu-Patong is a condominium by Origin Property on the Kathu side of the Kathu-Patong corridor. Listings describe studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom units with a built-up area of about 25 to 48 sqm.

Foreign buyers can own units as freehold, within the 49% foreign quota of the building. Sources report completion either in late 2025 or mid 2026, so ask us to confirm the current construction status.

Prices start from roughly 2.3 million baht in listings. Message us on WhatsApp for current availability.

The Origin Kathu-Patong: key facts

  • The Origin Kathu-Patong is a condominium in Kathu-Patong, Phuket, developed by Origin Property.
  • Units: 0–2 bedrooms, 25–48 sqm.
  • Construction status: status on request; completion listed as Jun 2026.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿2,310,000.
  • More projects by Origin Property in our catalogue: So Origin Kata Phuket.

Payment information

  • Reservation agreement with THB 100,000 booking fee
  • Contract signing with 20% deposit
  • Construction-linked installments for the remaining 80%
  • Ownership transfer / lease registration on completion
